column8: planet_threshold_desc:I always collected the first three on all sets. Decided whether to continue or travel after that.
column12: surprise_desc:The whole game.  If they were dropping in number quickly (for example half each dig) then I assessed how many it might drop to (guessing). Usually moved on when was predicted to be lower teens or certainly single digits for the most part
column16: other_desc:I am not sure but weighed time lost traveling and usually decided better to move on and have a chance of more (as they all started higher).
